svg.text: e-ink UI kit · 4.2-inch, 400 × 300, black and white
Four compartments in a 2 × 2 square. The screen draws the same square: a tile sits where its compartment sits.
small circle = the hidden button, under the front-right edge
Black tile = open the compartment in that spot
4 What the screen shows (most important first)
Container out 10 min → put it back (9)
Person leaves near a dose time → take it with you (8)
A dose time is open → the 2 × 2 map, black = open (4, 5)
AI: a usual outing is due → pack the next dose (13)
AI: 3 days of sachets or fewer → pharmacy day (12)
A dose time just ended with one unopened → slash, family told (10)
Someone within 1.5 m, nothing due → next dose time (3)
Nobody near → clock, weather, fine dust (1, 2, 11)
Hidden button: short press = today (15). Hold 3 s = refill mode (16).
E-ink: page change = full refresh; a tile flip = quiet partial refresh.
Type: Noto Sans KR 900 / 700 / 500 · numbers Schibsted Grotesk 800 / 700
Colour: ink #1B1B1B · paper #E8E7E1 · grey #8F8D86 (a 50% dither on the panel)
Clock, weather, fine dust; next dose time + 2×2 map
매우나쁨 + mask hint: the daily reason to look
Next dose time and which compartments
Black tile = open the compartment in that spot
Check + time replaces the black tile
Then the screen returns to the clock
No alarm; shows when it is next due
Dashed tile = put it back here
10 · Dose time ended, one not opened
Days left from the roll’s weight trend
Tuesday 10:30 outings → pack the lunch sachet
Refill mode for family or carer
